microtheory.name: extended_mind_distributed
microtheory.definition: Mind extends beyond skin + skull when tools + environment + others play same functional role as internal processing. Clark + Chalmers 1998 'Extended Mind'. Distributed cognition (Hutchins), socially extended cognition. Substrate analogue: substrate's tool-incorporation + multi-substrate distributed cognition.

concepts.name: extended_mind_thesis_em
concepts.definition: Clark + Chalmers 1998. Mental states extend into environment when external resources play same functional role as internal states. Otto's notebook example. Substrate analogue: substrate's tool-mediated cognition.

concepts.name: parity_principle
concepts.definition: Clark + Chalmers. If external resource plays same functional role as internal process, it's part of mind. Substrate analogue: substrate's functional-extension criterion.

concepts.name: otto_inga_thought_experiment
concepts.definition: Otto consults notebook for addresses; Inga consults memory. Functionally same. Otto's notebook is part of Otto's mind. Substrate analogue: substrate-with-tool as extended substrate.

concepts.name: coupling_constitutive
concepts.definition: When agent + tool coupled, tool is constitutive of cognitive system, not just causally related. Substrate analogue: substrate's tool-incorporation.

concepts.name: tool_use_extended
concepts.definition: Tools extending cognitive capacity. Calculators, writing, computers. Substrate analogue: substrate's external resource use.

concepts.name: cognitive_offloading
concepts.definition: Using external resources to reduce internal cognitive load. Substrate analogue: substrate's external memory use.

concepts.name: distributed_cognition
concepts.definition: Hutchins 1995. Cognition distributed across individuals + tools + environment in cognitive systems. Ship navigation, airline cockpits. Substrate analogue: substrate's multi-component cognitive system.

concepts.name: cognitive_ecosystem
concepts.definition: Ensemble of cognitive agents + tools + environment. Substrate analogue: substrate's full cognitive ecology.

concepts.name: cockpit_studies
concepts.definition: Hutchins. Cognition distributed across pilots + instruments + procedures. No individual holds whole solution. Substrate analogue: substrate-substrate-tool cognitive systems.

concepts.name: socially_extended_cognition
concepts.definition: Cognition distributed across multiple minds. Joint problem-solving. Substrate analogue: multi-substrate collaborative cognition.

concepts.name: transactive_memory
concepts.definition: Wegner. Couples remember-together by storing who knows what. Substrate analogue: multi-substrate distributed knowledge.

concepts.name: we_intentionality
concepts.definition: Tuomela. Shared intentionality going beyond individual. Substrate analogue: multi-substrate coordinated intent.

concepts.name: smartphone_extension
concepts.definition: Modern devices as cognitive extensions. Memory, navigation, calculation, communication. Substrate analogue: substrate's device-mediated cognition.

concepts.name: internet_extended_mind
concepts.definition: Search engines + reference resources extending memory + knowledge. Substrate analogue: substrate's network-extended cognition.

concepts.name: digital_extension
concepts.definition: Digital tools tightly coupled with users. Phones, computers, AR. Substrate analogue: substrate's digital-tool ecosystem.

concepts.name: writing_as_extension
concepts.definition: External symbol systems vastly extending memory + thinking. Substrate analogue: substrate's symbolic-extension.

concepts.name: mathematics_as_extension
concepts.definition: Formal notation extending mathematical capability. Cannot do calculus mentally. Substrate analogue: substrate's notational-extension.

concepts.name: language_as_extended_cognition
concepts.definition: Language as cognitive tool — for thinking + remembering, not just communicating. Substrate analogue: substrate's language-use for thought.

concepts.name: scaffolding_extended
concepts.definition: External structures supporting cognitive processes. Children's blocks, math notation. Substrate analogue: substrate's external-structure use.

concepts.name: epistemic_action
concepts.definition: Kirsh + Maglio. Action transforming environment to make cognition easier. Tetris rotation. Substrate analogue: substrate's environment-modification for cognition.

concepts.name: objections_em
concepts.definition: Adams + Aizawa: mark-of-mental. Rupert: hypothetical-process. Substrate analogue: substrate's extension-criterion debates.

concepts.name: criterion_mark_of_mental
concepts.definition: Objection: only internal processes have mental marks (non-derived content, etc.). Substrate analogue: substrate's internal-criterion question.

concepts.name: easy_hard_extended
concepts.definition: Easy: tools are causally important. Hard (controversial): they're constitutive. Substrate analogue: substrate's causal-vs-constitutive tool relation.

concepts.name: embedded_cognition
concepts.definition: Weaker than extended. Cognition embedded in environment without being constituted by it. Substrate analogue: substrate's situated-but-not-extended position.

concepts.name: embedded_embodied_extended_enactive
concepts.definition: Four E's. Different but related approaches to non-classical cognition. Substrate analogue: substrate's full post-classical framework.

rules.name: parity_principle_extends_mind
rules.head: an external resource plays same functional role as an internal cognitive process
rules.body: the external resource is part of the cognitive system. Clark + Chalmers. Substrate's tool-as-extension.

rules.name: coupling_makes_constitutive
rules.head: the substrate and a tool are tightly + persistently coupled
rules.body: the tool is constitutive of the cognitive system, not just causally related. Substrate's tool-incorporation.

rules.name: distributed_cognition_includes_collective_systems
rules.head: the substrate works as part of multi-component cognitive system
rules.body: the cognitive unit is the whole system, not individual components. Hutchins. Substrate's distributed analysis.

rules.name: epistemic_actions_offload_cognition
rules.head: the substrate transforms its environment to ease cognitive load
rules.body: the transformation is part of the cognitive process. Kirsh + Maglio. Substrate's environment-modification.

rules.name: writing_extends_memory_and_thought
rules.head: the substrate uses external symbolic representations
rules.body: memory + thought are extended beyond brain capacity. Substrate's symbolic extension.
